200211722.title: Transcriptional profiling of osteogenic medium calcified human primary coronary artery smooth muscle cells.
200211722.summary: Transcriptomics analysis of human coronary artery smooth muscle cells cultured in osteogenic medium (OM)  to induce a mineralized extracellular matrix. To study the underlying molecular mechanisms driving vascular calcification, we analyzed the transcriptome of osteogenic medium (OM)-calcified human coronary artery smooth muscle cells on day  7.
